description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Frequency once per day

Requirement The target is willing and has an open Slot.

Cost 2 points of Bloomrot charge, spent from either side

You force ten minutes of accelerated, directed growth into a willing creature, using your own Bloomrot charge as the engine instead of the usual downtime graft. Spend 2 points of Bloomrot charge, drawn from either side of the needle, and graft a Minor mutation of your choice from the Bloom Table into an open Slot on the target. No downtime ritual, no outside grafter — just growth that already knows where it's going.

cinderfall.incomplete: `BLOOMROT-NULL` (nothing to spend) plus bucket 4 (a cross-creature effect — granting a mutation to *another* actor's build). No selector for "add an item to a different actor" exists anywhere in `pf2e-source`; confirmed no novel shape for this class beyond the general absence.
